name: check
title: Checkbox
description: A native checkbox that submits, validates and takes Space with or without JavaScript. Quiet is a hairline box with a crisp tick drawn by CSS; warm sketches the box in four pencil strokes whose corners cross and draws a heavy tick in by hand; playful is a little rubber-stamp block, and stamps a bold tick over its edge, printed through the stamp's ink texture. Indeterminate, and a "select all" box that goes checked, mixed or clear with its children. Forced colours bring back the system checkbox.

budget.reason: Decision 0005: 12 KB of behaviour plus 8 KB for each of three skins. Today 16519 bytes: behaviour (check.js + check.core.js) 9.5 KB, skins quiet 0.2 KB, warm 2.2 KB, playful 4.2 KB. The playful skin also imports inkMask from stamp.core.js.
